extensions.name: rpi-ask-user-question
extensions.description: Structured ask_user_question tool: a questionnaire the model can put to you (1-4 questions, 2-4 described options each, optional markdown preview, multi-select, notes), rendered as an interactive overlay with an RPC dialog fallback.
extensions.descriptionZh: 结构化 ask_user_question 工具:模型在需求不清时向你发起的问卷(1-4 题、每题 2-4 个带描述选项、可选 markdown 预览、多选、备注),以交互式 overlay 渲染并提供 RPC 对话框降级。

extensions.name: rpi-plan-mode
extensions.description: Plan mode: /plan (or Shift+Tab) switches the session to a read-only research state where write tools are hidden; the model writes a structured plan with write_plan, and a review dialog approves it (returning to default mode to execute), requests revisions, or abandons it.
extensions.descriptionZh: 计划模式:/plan(或 Shift+Tab)把会话切到只读研究态,写类工具对模型隐藏;模型经 write_plan 产出结构化计划,批准流三选(批准并执行 / 继续修订 / 放弃)回到默认态执行。

extensions.name: rpi-smart-fetch
extensions.description: Fingerprinted web fetch extension: `web_fetch`/`batch_web_fetch` tools with browser-grade TLS/HTTP2 emulation (wreq), readability extraction (dom_smoothie [VARIANT]) with a 1:1 DOM fallback chain, five output formats, a structured error model, streaming progress (toolUpdate) and ComponentTree renderers.
extensions.descriptionZh: 指纹化网页抓取:`web_fetch`/`batch_web_fetch` 工具,浏览器级 TLS/HTTP2 指纹模拟(wreq)、readability 正文提取(dom_smoothie)与 1:1 DOM 回退链、五种输出格式、结构化错误模型、流式进度(toolUpdate)与组件树渲染。

extensions.name: rpi-statusline
extensions.description: Claude Code-compatible statusline: configure a shell command (CC stdin JSON contract) or declarative items (strict 21 fields, /statusline editor), rendered as footer/widget/status with event-driven and live refresh.
extensions.descriptionZh: Claude Code 兼容的自定义 statusline:可配置 shell 命令(CC stdin JSON 契约)或声明式 items(严格 21 字段、/statusline 编辑器),以 footer/widget/status 渲染,支持事件与实时刷新。

extensions.name: rpi-subagents
extensions.description: Delegation extension: single `subagent` tool that spawns focused child rpi sessions with per-agent prompts, tool allowlists and depth limits; composite tasks/steps runs (ADR-0018), background async runs (ADR-0019), managed worktree isolation, tool budgets, descendant allowlists and nested coordinators.
extensions.descriptionZh: 子代理委派:单个 `subagent` 工具派生专注的子 rpi 会话,支持 per-agent 提示词、工具白名单与深度限制;组合 tasks/steps 运行、后台异步运行、托管 worktree 隔离、工具预算、后代白名单与嵌套协调器。

extensions.name: rpi-todo
extensions.description: Task-list todo tool: a live overlay panel above the editor the model keeps current with one tool call (six actions, four-state machine, dependency tracking), rebuilt from the session branch so it survives compaction and /reload, plus a /todos command and a collapse shortcut.
extensions.descriptionZh: 任务清单工具:编辑器上方常驻 overlay 面板,模型经 todo 工具(六动作/四态状态机/依赖追踪)单次调用即可保持清单最新,从会话分支重放重建,跨 compaction 与 /reload 存活,附 /todos 命令与折叠快捷键。

extensions.name: rpi-usage
extensions.description: Usage lookup: /usage queries the current model provider's typed balance, plan quota or subscription windows through the host scripted usage-provider framework — built-in DeepSeek, GLM Coding Plan, MiniMax Token Plan, Kimi Code, OpenCode Go, Anthropic, OpenAI Codex and xAI scripts — and keeps a typed footer status line; --cached/--json/--provider and /usage list/help are supported, providers without quota show local session tokens only, and custom providers drop in as user scripts.
extensions.descriptionZh: 用量查询:/usage 经宿主脚本化 usage-provider 框架查询当前接入 provider 的类型化余额/套餐配额/订阅窗口(内置 DeepSeek/GLM Coding Plan/MiniMax Token Plan/Kimi Code/OpenCode Go/Anthropic/OpenAI Codex/xAI 八家脚本),footer 自动展示类型化状态行;支持 --cached/--json/--provider 与 /usage list/help,无配额 provider 只显示当前会话本地 token,用户脚本可扩展自定义 provider。
